description: This file defines the BreadCrumbStack class, which manages a breadcrumb navigation stack for tracking user navigation history within the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for adding, removing, and retrieving breadcrumb items, and interacts with the database to persist visibility states.

classes.name: BreadCrumbStack
classes.description: A class that manages a stack of breadcrumb items for user navigation history, with database synchronization and filtering capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the breadcrumb stack by retrieving user-specific tracking data from the database.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific item_id exists in the breadcrumb stack.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds a new breadcrumb item to the stack, updating visibility and maintaining uniqueness.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes the most recent breadcrumb item from the stack.

methods.name: makeItemInvisible
methods.description: Sets a breadcrumb item as invisible or deletes it from the database.

methods.name: popItem
methods.description: Removes a specific item from the stack by item_id.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds an item to the internal stack and updates the mapping.

methods.name: heal
methods.description: Rebuilds the stack and mapping arrays after removal of an item.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current number of items in the stack.

methods.name: getBreadCrumbList
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of breadcrumb items, optionally filtered by module.
